The company requests Commission approval to amend its filed Tariff Number 9.1 on Less than Statutory Notice to include a 
Special Fuel Surcharge Tariff Supplement to recover the rising cost of fuel. Fuel index prices have increased from $2.7304 per 
gallon for the base period to $6.0605 per gallon current price. Proposed changes are to add a Special Fuel Surcharge Supplement 
No. 1 in the amount of .33%.
